title: Italia Dance Music Radio - Signal Bloom

lines.l: in the corridor. Reflections bending out of form, no names, no trace, just motion in a vacant space.
You speak in tones I almost miss, a flicker card between the hits we calibrate in silent code,
Unwritten paths we never show
No symmetry, no map to hold
We drift where static turns to gold
A pulse beneath the fractured glass
We move, we echo, we bypass
Signal bloom in the afterglow
Patterns shift where we don't go
No gravity, no tethered line
Just fragments folding into time
Signal blue
All divine
Your outline warps beneath the light
A glitch that dances out of sight
We orbit through a frame unknown
No anchor, yet we're not alone
No crescendo, no dissent
Just resonance without intent
You vanish, but the trace remains
A whisper locked in sonic veins
Signal bloom in the afterglow
Patterns shift where we don't go

The moon fades, the room resets
